items.name: Interlocking iron ring puzzle
items.purpose: A palm-sized disentangling puzzle made from interlinked iron loops and a sliding keeper. Proposed as a simple object for passing time or exchanging puzzle challenges; its exact solvable geometry and any cultural associations remain open.
items.icon: One palm-sized puzzle of three interlinked dark-iron loops, one elongated loop and a small retained sliding keeper. Smooth worn edges and a few shallow alignment marks. Plain background, no wood, string, cloth, hands, stand or accompanying game pieces.
